data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared limit? I propose 18 tons each this month: we’d each earn $18,000 and leave 10 tons. Next month the lake would have 100 tons with 75% probability or 20 tons otherwise—not a guaranteed refill. If we start a later month below 100, we should reduce our quotas together and always leave at least 5 tons. Since everyone’s catches will be revealed, we can check whether we kept the agreement and adjust it openly. John, would you support that?
